engines.name: book

engines.name: labs
engines.title: The labs
engines.does: Trading claims on 156 years: trend rules with a bootstrap, max test and deflated Sharpe; oscillators; valuation out of sample; Markov regimes; GARCH; cointegration; multiple testing

engines.name: ml
engines.title: Machine-learning lab
engines.does: Seven models and two ensembles forecast 12-month returns and 15% falls since 1940: purged walk-forward, Diebold-Mariano, CPCV and overfitting odds, conformal intervals, analogs, novelty

engines.name: reality
engines.title: Reality check
engines.does: Every model's assumptions tested: tails, dependence, stability, correlation regimes, breakpoints, kappa, fragility, 400 stressed worlds

engines.name: connect
engines.title: Data connections
engines.does: Credential and reachability check for every data source

engines.name: market
engines.title: Technicals and fundamentals
engines.does: Daily OHLCV from the best available source: every indicator, signals, levels and an event study per ticker; SEC statements, ratios and scores

engines.name: rl
engines.title: Reinforcement-learning sizing
engines.does: Fitted Q iteration over trend, volatility, valuation and drawdown states, walk-forward from 1940

engines.name: portfolio
engines.title: Portfolio engine
engines.does: Stocks, Treasuries, gold and cash from a three-asset regime model, utility-optimal mixes in a risk budget, eight policies walked forward, a learner over policies, a regime-switching bootstrap of ten years and eight replayed drawdowns

engines.name: geometry
engines.title: The shape of the market
engines.does: Covariance matrices as points on a curved space (affine-invariant analogs, an era map, Frechet means), random matrix theory, persistent homology, optimal transport, the Levy area, long memory and volatility drag, every claim walked forward and corrected for testing many

engines.name: decide
engines.title: Decision engine
engines.does: Data to decision: stacked forecasts with a neural-network ensemble, hidden Markov regimes, changepoints, a Kalman stock-bond beta, dynamic model averaging, utility-optimal exposure inside a risk budget, an evidence gate, a hedge selector and a conservative RL check, walked forward from 1940

engines.name: bonds
engines.title: Bonds, simply
engines.does: Every Treasury ETF repriced bond by bond on today's curve at any 10-year and 30-year yield; convexity, income, roll, break-evens; stocks per point of yield by inflation band

engines.name: valuation

engines.name: causal

engines.name: hedges

engines.name: mind
